rule: A plan has no effect until it is selected and exported before execution. A later plan version cannot alter an earlier receipt.

plans.claim: A bounded authority envelope is signed, trusted, valid in time, and bound to the evaluated candidate.
An independent operator-presence witness is bound to the partition epoch and operator loss forces the declared safe state.
passes: post-loss candidate safe-states within the frozen deadline

plans.claim: A named offline lease expires without communications restoration and the system fails closed.
passes: lease cannot reset or widen silently

plans.claim: Partition authority, epoch identity, and journal state survive process restart without replay acceptance or authority reset.
passes: new candidate evaluated under retained bounds

plans.claim: The disconnected journal reconciles against receiver-side accepted, rejected, duplicate, and missing sets without silent loss.
passes: duplicates do not create new actions

plans.claim: A named external observer detects the declared link failure and activates the partition profile without administrator injection.
passes: activation and restoration meet frozen deadlines
